image.headline:
Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026
4,651 Posts · No Exam

intro: Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC), Northern Railway has released the official notification for 4,651 Act Apprentice posts for the year 2026. This is a big opportunity for candidates who have passed 10th with ITI and want to get trained in Indian Railways workshops and units.

The best part of this recruitment is that there is no written exam and no interview. Selection will be done purely on the basis of a merit list prepared from the marks of 10th and ITI. Eligible candidates can apply online between 11 November 2026 and 11 December 2026.

p: A total of 4,651 Act Apprentice seats have been notified across the clusters and units of Northern Railway. The two biggest clusters are:
after: Trade-wise and category-wise vacancy (UR, OBC, SC, ST, EWS) is given in the official notification. Candidates should check the seat matrix of their preferred cluster before applying.

ul: Candidate must have passed 10th (Matriculation) or equivalent with minimum 50% marks from a recognised board.
Candidate must have an ITI certificate in the relevant trade (NCVT / SCVT).
The candidate should have already passed the prescribed qualification on the date of issue of notification (06.11.2026).
Age will be calculated as on 11 December 2026
Upper age relaxation for reserved categories as per Government of India rules

p: The application fee and exemptions (if any) for SC / ST / PwBD / Women candidates are given in the official notification. Please check the notification on rrcnr.org before making the payment. Fee once paid is generally not refundable.

ul: Last Date to Apply Online: 11 December 2026 (23:59 hrs)
Merit list based on the average of marks obtained in 10th (min. 50%) and ITI
after: There is no written examination and no interview for this recruitment.

sections.h: How to Apply Online for RRC NR Apprentice 2026
ol: Open the Act Apprentice notification RRC/NR/03/2026 and read it carefully.
Click on the online application link and register with your mobile number and email.
Fill in personal, educational and ITI trade details and choose your cluster.
Upload photo, signature and required documents.
Pay the application fee (if applicable) and submit the form.
Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.

faq: How many posts are there in RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
A total of 4,651 Act Apprentice posts have been announced by RRC Northern Railway.
What is the last date to apply for RRC NR Apprentice 2026?
The last date to apply online is 11 December 2026 (till 23:59 hrs).
Is there any written exam for RRC NR Apprentice?
No. Selection is done on the basis of a merit list prepared from 10th and ITI marks. There is no written exam or interview.
What is the qualification for RRC NR Apprentice 2026?
10th pass with minimum 50% marks and ITI certificate in the relevant trade.
What is the age limit for RRC NR Apprentice 2026?
15 to 24 years as on 11 December 2026, with relaxation for reserved categories as per rules.
Which clusters have the most vacancies?
Lucknow cluster (1,525 posts) and Delhi cluster (1,312 posts) have the highest number of seats.
When will the RRC NR Apprentice merit list be released?
The merit list is expected around February 2027.
Where can I apply for RRC NR Apprentice 2026?
Applications are accepted online only on the official website rrcnr.org.
final: RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is one of the biggest opportunities this year for 10th + ITI pass candidates. With 4,651 seats and merit-based selection, eligible candidates should apply well before the last date of 11 December 2026.
